shotLimitScale.description: Scales the shot limit of the levels that have one (36 of 50, 25-100 shots; never below 5). Levels without a limit stay unlimited. In a level in play, the shots left change by the same amount as the limit (never below 1). Fewer shots make the goal harder to reach.

specialBubbleRate.description: Scales each level's chance that the next bubble is a special one (bomb or rainbow; 0-25% in most levels, capped at 100%). Specials clear bubbles in bulk, so lower values make the game harder and more about aiming. Applies to the next bubble drawn.

aimGuide.description: 1 shows the dotted aiming line and its wall-bounce preview while the player drags; 0 hides them, so the player has to judge angles and bank shots unaided. Applies immediately.
